basis: source traversal and locked baseline reproduction before production edits

authorities.fallback: union of every older complete retained Snapshot.owned map, including third root after interrupted retirement
authorities.runtime: NodeId descriptions own byte vectors; conservatively annotated on matching disk owners, no independent physical backing outside closure union
authorities.pending: complete Plan.admission.blocks held in Filesystem.quarantine under exclusive owner
authorities.orphan: current mapped node and extent/directory closure plus orphan record, copied even when unpinned until explicit reap
authorities.quarantine: failed publication retains plan; any uncertain/degraded owner denies mutation and marks all segments quarantined
authorities.cleaner: full immutable plan; no target intersects any initially retained occupied segment

sets.protected: C_current UNION C_fallbacks UNION P_pending; runtime bytes covered by copied object ownership; degraded volumes deny all reuse
sets.occupied_segments: unique segment indices of protected block union
sets.reusable: all complete segment blocks minus whole occupied segment capacity; never snapshot free_blocks header
sets.ordinary_admissible: reusable >= round_up(actual transaction blocks, segment_blocks) + SB.cleaner_reserve
sets.cleaner_admissible: actual rounded full snapshot <= SB.cleaner_reserve - floor AND reusable - rounded snapshot >= floor; floor=2*geometry.metadata_bound+3
sets.retirement: only oldest CP slot zero followed by successful R or R0 flush releases its closure; all initially protected blocks excluded from target planning even when R0 will retire them

shared_internal_metadata: bootstrap generations share equal Owner references; conflicting owners rejected at mount; never relocated while shared with fallback
obsolete: old unreferenced bytes and unused offsets carry no authority; offsets in an occupied segment remain unavailable until complete segment release
